title: My Neighborhood
text:
I live on a small street in a quiet neighborhood. There is a park near my house. Children play in the park after school. There is also a small shop on the corner.

Every morning I walk to the shop with my dog. The man in the shop is very friendly. He always says hello to me. I like my neighborhood because it is safe.

questions.text: What does the man in the shop always do?
options: He says hello to the writer

questions.text: How does the writer probably feel about the neighborhood?
What can we guess about the writer's daily life?
options: The writer lives somewhere they feel at home
The writer wants to move away soon
The writer does not know anyone nearby
The writer is afraid to go outside

vocabulary.definition: the area around the place where you live
a public area with grass and trees
a place where you buy things

paragraph_translations: Mieszkam na małej ulicy w spokojnej okolicy. Blisko mojego domu jest park. Dzieci bawią się w parku po szkole. Na rogu jest też mały sklep.
Każdego ranka chodzę z psem do sklepu. Mężczyzna w sklepie jest bardzo miły. Zawsze wita się ze mną. Lubię swoją okolicę, ponieważ jest bezpieczna.
